# Carlos Volweides — Fullstack Engineer

Carlos Volweides is a fullstack engineer based in Caracas, Venezuela.
Specializes in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), React, Next.js, React Native.
Focuses on clean architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event-driven systems, and LLM/RAG integration.
Available for remote work. Open to work as of 2025.

## Experience

- Digitan Agency (2025–present): Fullstack Developer. Builds end-to-end web and mobile applications
  for logistics, billing systems, and multi-app integrations using Next.js, FastAPI, React Native,
  PostgreSQL, and AWS.

## Projects

- **Atlas Protocol** (MVP, closed beta): AI-powered platform for generating personalized technical courses.
  RAG system over indexed content, LLM-powered study path generation, WebSocket agent chat.
  Stack: Next.js, Supabase, Vercel AI SDK, FastAPI.

- **Repositorio UGMA** (deployed, internal): Institutional thesis repository for Universidad Gran Mariscal
  de Ayacucho. 1,200+ users, 247 theses indexed. Approval workflow for coordinators and search for students.
  Stack: PHP, JavaScript, SQL, NoSQL.

- **Luxdata** (shipped): Hotel management system with reservations, check-in/out, billing, room blocking,
  and dashboards. Stack: React, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS, MySQL.

## Education

## Site

This portfolio is built with Astro, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel.
Source code: available on request.

Bilingual: Spanish is served at the root (/, /projects, /projects/<slug>) and English
under the /en prefix (/en, /en/projects, /en/projects/<slug>). Both languages carry the
same content and are linked via hreflang.
